Name: Floral Megamix
Author: Timmeep
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=5]This version of Timsanity's Floral Megamix is no longer supported. Please check out the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28133] Content Patcher Remake[/url] of my mod.[/size][/b]
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=4]A whopping [/size][b][size=5]190 Crops[/size][/b][size=4] (most of them with multi-yields), and [/size][b][size=5]301 items.[/size][/b][size=4] [/size]
[size=3]7 Fruit Trees, and 2 of them are only available if you have [b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8256]Raffadax[/url] (Complete Production, NOT LIGHT)[/b] installed…
5 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11778]Market Day[/url] Booths!
2 Crops only from the Casino Club, and 1 crop from Qi's Walnut Room!
Farm Type Manager Support, and also rare star fragments, and you get a good amount of them on the beach every day 27![/size]
[size=3]2 New Gems, Sapphire & Full-Moon Jewel.[/size]

[size=5][b]Compatibility [/b][/size]
[size=3]My crocus, holly, and mushroom crops that overlap only get disabled when Mae's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2815]Forage to Farm Mod[/url] is present. If you want to play megamix along with raffadax without forage to farm, delete the crocus crop in my mod.
The sapphire in this mod only gets disabled if you raffadax installed, and I can't also make it disabled with Kaya's More Gems mod because technical limitations, so if you want to play with Kaya's Mor Gems, but not raffadax, make sure to delete the sapphire from my mod before playing with Kaya's More Gems.
There is now actual compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2075]F2F[/url].
And also compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6113]this,[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12870]this,[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3438]that.
[/url]Oh yeah since my mod has green mushrooms, there's compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] too.
Apparently, [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpacks[/url][size=3] makes all the multi-yield harvest rules [/size][b][size=4]NOT WORK AT ALL.[/size] [/b][size=3]I don't know for sure if that's even the case, but watch out for that.[/size]

[b][size=5]Future Content:[/size][/b]
[size=3]The creatures from the garden events as custom critters, as well as custom companions![/size]
[size=3]Localization for most the crops and items beyond Japanese.[/size][size=3]
More crops in the future...


...but for now, I am taking a break since I have worked on this for 2 months at this point.[/size]

[b][size=5]Credits:[/size][/b]
[size=3]Midori for helping my out on a few of these flowers![/size]
[size=3]Mizu for the gem & mineral crop sprites which she made, the rose starter trellis and seeds, as well as the[/size]
[size=3]rose sprite that the Void Rose & Gold Rose use! and also the crops for herbal lavender and sweet jasmine (Mizu said it was ok to use [/size][size=3]her sprites, as long as you give credit.) [/size][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/[/url]
[size=3]Special Thanks to Raffadax for letting me use items from his mod, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8256]Raffadax Complete Production!

[/url][/size]Oh yeah one more thing if you love this mod, please endorse, it helps out a lot![/font]
